product.description: Monoprice™Standard Size Keystone Plate 2‑Port, UL®Dual‑Connection Wall Panel for Reliable Network, Audio, and Video IntegrationThe Standard Size Keystone Plate 2‑Port is a professional‑grade wall plate designed to deliver both functionality and style for structured cabling projects. Built to accommodate two keystone jacks, this plate provides an organized and efficient solution for network, audio/video, voice, or data connections, making it ideal for both residential and commercial installations.Crafted with a sleek black or gray finish, the Keystone Plate blends seamlessly into modern interiors while maintaining a low‑profile appearance. Its durable thermoplastic construction ensures long‑lasting performance, even in high‑traffic areas, while resisting scratches, fading, and wear. Whether used in offices, conference rooms, data centers, or home theater systems, this wall plate delivers a polished, professional look that enhances cable management and keeps wiring neat and secure.Engineered for convenience, this plate is compatible with a wide range of snap‑in keystone modules, including RJ45 Ethernet, HDMI®, coaxial, and fiber optic connectors. The dual‑port configuration allows you to combine multiple connection types within one plate, maximizing efficiency and flexibility. With its standard single‑gang size, it easily fits into existing electrical boxes and mounting brackets, making installation quick and straightforward for professionals and DIY users alike.UL listed for safety and quality assurance, this Standard Size Keystone Plate meets industry standards, giving installers and end users confidence in its reliability. It supports clean, clutter‑free cabling solutions that not only look better but also improve performance by protecting connections from stress and damage.This product is particularly well‑suited for structured wiring systems where expandability is important. The two‑port design provides room for growth, allowing you to add or update connections as technology evolves without replacing the entire plate. Combined with its universal compatibility and elegant finish, this is a versatile solution for future‑proofing installations.Whether you're upgrading a home office, setting up an enterprise network, or streamlining A/V connections in a boardroom, this Standard Size Keystone Plate 2‑Port delivers a professional finish, reliable performance, and long‑term value.
